faq_1_q: How do I find out what a project will cost?
faq_1_a: Message us or leave a request — we'll discuss the task in chat or on a call and propose a solution with timelines and terms.
faq_2_q: How long will a project take?
faq_2_a: A landing page or bot takes 1–3 weeks, a web service or SaaS 4 to 12 weeks. We agree on an exact schedule with demo dates before we start.
faq_3_q: Do you work under a contract?
faq_3_a: Yes, always. The contract fixes the scope, timelines and transfer of rights to the code and design.
faq_4_q: Can we start with a small phase?
faq_4_a: Yes. We often start with an MVP or a single module to get results quickly, then grow the product.
faq_5_q: How many revisions can I make?
faq_5_a: Two rounds of design revisions and any bug fixes before handover. You see the product every week and can adjust course.
faq_6_a: 30 days of free support. After that, it's up to you: ongoing maintenance or new features.
faq_7_a: Yes, we sign an NDA before discussing project details if you need one.
faq_8_q: What do you need from us?
faq_8_a: A description of the task in your own words, access to the relevant systems and one point of contact for 1–2 hours a week for demos and feedback.
